title: Sullivan, Miney John and the drummer Bolegs
summary: Joseph recalls Sullivan on clarinet, the trumpeter Miney John, his own trio with his brother at First and Liberty, and the drummer Bolegs who was refused Claven Williams's daughter.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Sure. All them fellas. What did he play, Sullivan? Sullivan. He tried to play clarinet. Mm-hmm. He wasn't much on it. And let's see. Well, Miney was from up around there. Miney was on this side of the river. They was from the other side of the river. Oh. Miney was, yeah, Miney. I know him where. Miney John.
Did he play with him much or was he? He was a good trumpet player. Miney was a good trumpet player. I didn't know he was.

He was a trumpet, he was an E flat trumpet player. Really? I didn't know. In Brasgow. He played trumpet, but I don't know. He played trumpet. But I don't know. Yeah, I heard him on piano. I heard him on piano. I heard him on trumpet. You know what we did? That's before, when they, before they put up the band, me and my brother played guitar, First and Liberty. You know that shop you went to, First and Liberty? First time. Him on guitar. I played the bass. And Walmart bro played the violin. Walmart bro played with Duke. Yeah, sure. We played a picnic under the tree for them to get the instrument. Bolegs and all that. You ever heard of Bolegs? Mm-hmm. I haven't heard of them. Miney John's.
Now who is Bolegs? What did he do? Good.

Good drummer. Yeah, he died, died here. Who did he play with? Oh, he played with the best when he was down here. He played with Claven Williams. And Claven couldn't see him. He was going to see Claven's daughter. But that family couldn't see him because he's an ugly guy, you know. Figured that his daughter was too much. Was he dark or had bad hair or what? He was dark as my shoe. I had a good place who got done my drum. So Claven didn't agree for him to marry his daughter. Marry his daughter. That's right. That's right. He died down here. They didn't stay together though. She's got a big place of business in Downsville now. She's a good piano player. What kind of place does she have? Be a part. Be a part.
